quests.title: Where Does Her Name Rest?

dialogue.t: I have confirmed that you are all in good health. With that, my work is now complete. Congratulations are in order.
It's good to know you're all well. Puts me at ease.
Are these people...?
Judging by their clothes, they appear to be phantom Hyperboreans from the distant past.
That could mean they have some clues about the Moon Goddess's name, right?
Hey there, could you tell us what the Moon Goddess's name is?
Hmm?
Uh, sorry. That's probably a weird question, huh... How do we explain this?
The moons are long gone, and their goddesses are dead. Their names no longer mean anything.
When a new Moon Goddess is born, we will surely know her name.
We have used every last resource at our disposal. All that remains is to wait, patiently and quietly...
Were the people of the past all this devout? Hmm. It looks like this phantom doesn't intend to converse with us any further.
Surely, the new Moon Goddess he speaks of must be Columbina.
Alas, Kuutar's birth came long after the age in which he lived.
Mm... But, um... Maybe if we... find a phantom from a more recent age, they might know Columbina's real name?
True. Keep an eye out. We should be able to tell which era they're from by the clothes they wear.

dialogue.sit: Nicole? Nothing to say on the matter?

dialogue.t: Yeah... You've been pretty talkative this whole time.... What changed?
Oh... Nothing, I'm fine. You all make good points.
When the Hyperboreans speak of moon goddesses, they mean the three from truly ancient times. I can't imagine they would know anything about our current Moon Goddess.

There once was a time when the moon goddesses blessed them greatly and protected them from harm. So, when the war between the gods and dragons plunged the world into chaos, it seems they looked once more to the moons for help, praying for a new goddess to be born.
Yeah, that checks out.
Let's continue on. Who knows what else we may discover.
When the moons rise again, we shall receive their protection once more...
Even in the darkest hour, there is always a way out...
The moons have left for now... but they would not abandon us forever...
Ooh, there's a whole bunch of artwork in here... Seems pretty old. Nicole, this is probably your area of expertise — what do all these paintings mean?
Let me see... Hmm.
To understand these murals requires some knowledge of the history surrounding the war of funerary flame. I shared a little of this with Lauma before.
Hmm... Yes, I think I follow. The dispute between the moon sisters, the transformation by Nibelung...

dialogue.sit: Maybe it's one to save for when we get back?

dialogue.t: Oh, no, it's no trouble! I'd be delighted to share the tale again!
A—Alright then...
Teyvat's three moons and their goddesses were brought into being by the will of Nibelung, the then-ruler of Teyvat.
But when the Heavenly Principles came, they changed the world completely, down to its very foundations.
The moon goddesses were nowhere near strong enough to challenge this entity. But the Heavenly Principles did not view them as heretical entities that had to be removed.

Essentially, the three moons existed to keep this planet alive and operational, which did not directly conflict with the Heavenly Principles' aims. Nevertheless, the inherent precariousness of this arrangement would soon be revealed...
Nibelung returned, yes?
He did, and thus began the war of funerary flame. A battle for dominance between Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles.
Discord would soon emerge between the three moon sisters. One would voice the opinion that they should follow Nibelung, for it was he who first hung the moons in the sky.
Another would argue that taking sides in the conflict would only bring the world closer to ruin. There was no telling where it would lead.
Especially since their creator had returned bearing the perilous power of the Abyss.
Nibelung would eventually discover their disloyalty. He had all three imprisoned before transforming the moons into weapons with which to fight against the Heavenly Principles.
What? Weapons!?
Yes. The very moons that had once defended the planet became instruments of death and destruction, striking terror into the hearts of all living things.
And although the Heavenly Principles and the three moon sisters had once been at peace, it now seemed that the moons posed an unacceptable threat to Teyvat.

It is possible that the Heavenly Principles did not know of the goddesses' imprisonment. If so, the weaponization of the moons would surely have been viewed as an intentional breach of the peace agreement.
Regardless of who knew what when, the Heavenly Principles shattered two moons, and flung the other beyond the skies.
Whether the goddesses managed to escape Nibelung's captivity after his fall, nobody knows.
But this much is certain: From that day on, the moons no longer belonged to Teyvat. The rejection slowly drained their power until eventually, they passed away.
So that's the full story...
You say the moons ceased belonging to Teyvat from then on. Why, then, would Columbina be born here?
That is perhaps due to the lingering connection between the Frost Moon, which was not shattered, and this world. You could see it as the three sisters' dying wish.
They never desired war. All they ever wished for was to protect this land.
...I see.
If the final fate of the three goddesses is as you say, then Columbina faces the same grave danger.
Our investigation has yet to bear fruit. We must hurry.
Yeah, you're right. Let's keep going!
We're finally here... Guessing we'll need to activate this thing?
Indeed. I was a little worried about that at first, but as we got closer, I sensed that the kuuvahki within it flows unimpeded. It should be functioning normally.
The only issue is how to activate it... It's looking a little worse for wear...
What about the cores from some of the other devices we've seen? Can we repair it using those?
In all likelihood, yes. I imagine that would have been the Hyperboreans' backup plan. Let's look for some cores.

dialogue.sit: (The shelves are stacked with books. Unfortunately, none are related to the birth of a new Moon Goddess, and there is no mention of a "Columbina.")

dialogue.t: Should we trust him to keep his promise?
We have to. There's nothing else we can do.
Why? Why do the creators of this world no longer show mercy upon their people?
Remember his words... we must change our fate... with our own hands...
This is where the people of Hyperborea communicated with the moons.
We need only place the Moon Marrow upon this platform on Moon-Prayer Night, and we shall be able to open a portal to the moon and send our Moon Goddess back home.
The assumption being, of course, that we can find her first.

dialogue.sit: The moon is... beyond the sky, right?

dialogue.t: That's right... You want to know if it's safe there, don't you?

dialogue.sit: Exactly. It might have been corrupted by the Abyss.

dialogue.t: And yet she has no choice but to return. You know this.
That's not the only issue here... This is the end of the line, right? We've explored everything we can.
But despite looking at historical artwork and talking to people from Hyperborean times... We're still no closer to learning Columbina's name.
Hmm... If it's not too much trouble, could you tell me exactly what Alice said to you about "finding her name"?
Oh, sure. What she said was...
Then your first job is to find it. As a Moon Goddess, I'm sure she must have a name she identifies with.
Neither "Columbina" nor "Kuutar" is her true name, and she's never really accepted either of them.
...Is it not also possible that... She has never had a true name? Not at any point in history?
That would be a hard pill to swallow. But at this point, we may have to accept that that is the truth.
No one knows how she came into being, and she certainly doesn't have "parents" in any sense that we're aware of. Perhaps... she was never granted a name at all.
But... Does that mean there's no way to get Columbina back? She's just gonna disappear, and there's nothing we can do about it?
Huh...? Wait... Why all this pessimism? Was it the way I phrased this question? You all seem to be taking this in completely the wrong way...

dialogue.sit: What do you mean by that...?

dialogue.t: Well, just because she's never had a real name in the past doesn't mean she can't have one now!
...What?
Think about what Alice said again. She never once said that you'd have to find a "new" name, did she?
Are you saying what I think you're saying?

dialogue.sit: You want us to grant her a name?

dialogue.t: Yes. Names are anchors that connect us to the world. If she doesn't have one already, then all we have to do is create one! No?
It's like... Ah, yes! {NICKNAME}, when you first arrived in Teyvat, do you think you would have turned around if someone behind you shouted out "Hey, Tumaini!"
And now?
I understand what you mean.
Life is a long journey. Even the friends and family by our side can change over time.
When people call you by different names, what matters isn't so much the words themselves, but what they symbolize.
And of course... whether that resonates with you.
So, close your eyes and picture the Moon Goddess in your mind. If you were to call out to her in this moment, what would you say?
Columbina.
Paimon would call her Columbina too.
She has long forsaken everything that "Kuutar" represents... I think... from now on, I should call her Columbina, too.
Well, it sounds to me like you've found your answer.
Are you sure? Is it really that simple? We haven't found her this whole time, and not for lack of trying!
For a journey like this, the process is every bit as important as the outcome.
Had you not searched far and wide, rejecting every other answer you were offered, how could you have come to an answer you felt was finally correct?
Ohh! It all makes sense now... This has Alice's fingerprints all over it...
Are you suggesting that mage knew from the start that Columbina never had a real name to begin with?
Um... I can't say for sure. But I can definitely imagine her chuckling in satisfaction somewhere right now, saying, "Ah, what fun!"
Lauma! Your antlers!
...You should hurry. The festive moon has begun to rise.
Do not worry, for when you called the name "Columbina" just now, I could sense that the power within was enough to summon back the moon goddess.
The power within what? The name...?
Yes, so... the thing is... Ugh... Gah!
Umm... What's wrong now?
This is so annoying! Gah! I really, really, really want to explain how that whole thing works! Starting from the founding principles of Teyvat, and... Oh, I could talk about this for hours!
But...! Deep breaths, Nicole, deep breaths. You're an angel, a sober, sensible, solemn angel who has her priorities straight!
Um... Okay then. Sorry for asking. Clearly a bad call on Paimon's part.
...Anyway! You all need to hurry! Last thing: Remember how it felt when you called out that name.
Then it is agreed...
By the name "Columbina" we shall find her...
Then we'll throw her the best Moon-Prayer Night party ever!

dialogue.sit: And at last, we will send her home.

dialogue.t: They... didn't make it...
My name...

dialogue.sit: Could you tell me your name?
Could you tell me your name?

dialogue.t: My name... is...
...Huh?
n/a

dialogue.sit: Columbina... That's the name you gave when we first met
Columbina... That's the name you gave when we first met
And it's what I've called you ever since
And it's what I've called you ever since

dialogue.t: Columbina...

dialogue.sit: I have many fond memories of Columbina...
I have many fond memories of Columbina...
And so do all of your friends
And so do all of your friends

dialogue.t: Looking for me?
n/a
I like it
You can carry on using it
My name is:
Columbina Hyposelenia
I... can barely move anymore...
My consciousness... is fading away...
Have they come back out? I... I'd love to see them one more time...

dialogue.sit: Columbina Hyposelenia. That's a wonderful name.

dialogue.t: I never thought that "Columbina" would become my real name.
But after I met you, and my other friends, the things that this name stood for slowly began to change.
It went being from a Fatui codename... to "something my friends call me."

dialogue.sit: (How much she's changed since we first met... She never used to share her innermost thoughts.)

dialogue.t: Hmm? What is it? Why aren't you saying anything?

dialogue.sit: I'm just so happy for you.

dialogue.t: Hehe, thank you. So, where's everyone else?

dialogue.sit: We can go and meet them very soon. Everyone went to different places to try calling your name.

dialogue.t: Great. I'd like to thank them as well. Everyone's done so much for me — searching for my name, entering those ancient ruins...
Yes, I was there. Not physically, but my consciousness was still holding on. I followed you the whole way.
You turned around and called out my name while you were in Nasha Town. Do you remember?

dialogue.sit: (I could've sworn I felt someone pat me on the back... And deep down, I think I knew that it was Columbina.)

dialogue.t: Let's go. We don't want to keep them waiting.

dialogue.sit: Sure. In that case, come with me.

dialogue.t: Ah, but...
Before that... Could you call my name one more time?

dialogue.sit: Sure. Come with me, Columbina Hyposelenia.
Columbina spreads the good news to your friends by way of small animals and kuuhenki...

quests.description: Seek her name within the boundless sea called “the past”…

quests.title: The Night the Moon Returns Home

dialogue.t: This feels like... the surprise of my life.
I do. I never imagined I'd ever get to enjoy Moon-Prayer Night with everyone so freely...
Hehe, if you're happy, we're happy!

Quite a strategy you came up with — hide the tree in the forest... It's not your usual style, Lauma. Is there something about Moon-Prayer Night that enhances what's in your head as well as the antlers on top?
Apparently so. It even inspired a perennial penny pincher to use their resources for a greater cause. It truly is a magical festival.
(I see it now. This bickering is actually a sign of a strong relationship.)
Huh? What's everyone doing here?
Oh! Miss Columbina! You're back!
Yes. I'm fine now... thanks for your concern.
How's your progress with Alice's assignment?
Very well indeed. I've never heard her sound so excited.
Not like this... This time, her excitement seems more serious. Seems like she's had a major breakthrough.
She said she'll contact us once she knows more. In the meantime, we're free to relax and have some fun.
Enjoy the time off while it lasts. I have a feeling that our next task won't be so simple.
Mm... I should go. I still have a few things to attend to at the Frostmoon Scions' stall.
And I think I'll take a look around. With any luck, this once-in-a-year festival will come with once-in-a-year opportunities.
Hold up a second, where's Varka?
I believe he made a beeline for The Flagship the moment he entered Nasha Town.
Ah. That's Mondstadters for you — they know what they want when festivals roll around...
Goodbye for now, Columbina. I hope you have a wonderful night.
I will.
Hehe, well in that case, don't just stand there — get out there and have some fun! You'll definitely get a warm welcome at every stall!
Oh, also — take this map with you. It's a guide to the festival.
The Frostmoon Scions' stall is over here. Lauma's invited a whole bunch of cute animals to celebrate too.
Over there is the Hexenzirkel section. Alice seemed more excited than anyone about this festival, so she insisted on making it a grand affair.
Oh, and then there's the Nasha Town local specialties, including... actually, forget that, better if you go check them out for yourself!
Thank you. It looks like a lot of fun.
You're not coming with me?
We'll be around! But don't you wanna browse by yourself for a bit first?
Um...
Yup! If you find something you like and wanna try it out together, just give us a shout — we'll be right with you!
Otherwise, just relax and enjoy yourself! There's so much on offer, so try to experience as much as you can... and don't forget to stuff yourself with all the delicious festival food!

dialogue.sit: We'll probably run into each other while we're browsing.

dialogue.t: Haha. Alright, then... Off I go.

dialogue.section: Sneak into the Hydro Slime box
Sneak into the Pyro Slime box

dialogue.t: (Wow. The Frostmoon Scions' stall looks kinda plain, but it's pretty cool once you get into it.)
(I don't go to Hiisi Island much, but it's got that, like... "olde worlde" cultural feel.)
(Heh, and if culture means we get more festivals, I'm all for it!)
Hello, Jahoda.
Whoa! Columbin— Uhh, hello, Moon Goddess!
(That was too close! I almost gave the game away in front of the staff! ...Wait, what's the deal with her shoes? They don't make a sound when she walks! I could do with a pair of those...)
Do you like balloons too?
Balloons? Oh... you mean those.
(What's so fun about balloons? I'm not a kid anymore... They're probably more up Aino's alley.)
Yes. The animals seem very curious about these strange flying objects. I was drawn here by their voices.
I recently learned a fun new game you can play with balloons, so I decided to come and give it a try.
A new game...?
Hello.
Ah, welcome home, Moon Goddess. Here to buy some balloons?
Yes. Could you give me a few that haven't been inflated yet?
Hmm? Are you sure? ...I guess it's not a problem, but...
Yes please. Thank you.
(Uninflated balloons? But those are just... little rubber pouches. What does she want with those?)
Would you like to play the balloon game, Jahoda?
Huh? Uh, sure, I guess? How do you play it...?
Wait here a moment.
Oh...
(Ugh... This is so weird. What have I gotten myself into now?)
Hmm? I thought I saw Columbina nearby.
(Uh-oh! That's... The Fourth Harbinger! ...Although, she's helped us out quite a bit. She's good people, right?)
(Is she looking for Columbina? Phew. Guess that's my ticket out of here. I'm not sure my heart can take being sandwiched between two Harbingers!)
(Which stall is she checking out? Oh, it's that other Frostmoon Scions one — try on the headgear, see what it's like having antlers or animal ears for a day.)
(I wouldn't be caught dead wearing that stuff... So embarrassing. I have enough gear to carry as it is...)
(Wait, what!? She put it on!?)
(...How peculiar. This would take some getting used to... I wonder if this is what it's like for Lynette?)
It really suits you, Ma'am.
(What is this? She was so intimidating a moment ago, but now... Dang, she's really rockin' those ears! How does she make 'em look so cool?)
(Hmph... I suppose I may as well keep them on for now. All part of the festive experience.)
Hmm?
(She's coming this way!)
How do you do, Miss Jahoda?
(Oh geez, don't talk to me while wearing that thing! Where am I supposed to look!?)
Oh, uh... Hey there.
I'm looking for Columbina. Have you seen her?
Ah, sh—she, she just... Huh!?
Hehe.
(W—W—Wait, is THAT what she meant by "balloon game"—)
...Hyah!
No fair, how come I get caught in the crossfire!?
An ambush from the rear? Is this a declaration of war, Columbina?
Would you like to play too, Arlecchino?
(Seriously!? Are they gonna start some beef right here, right now?)
Gladly. That said, I believe there is another who would like to join.
...! Boss! Boss Nef! Thank goodness! You've gotta get me outta here, things are kicking off big time!
Hello there. I'd like ten... No, make that twenty balloons, please. Uninflated.
...Huh?
Miss Moon Goddess, I hope you're prepared to pay the price for assaulting my employee?
Haha. Welcome to the game, Nefer.
Just to be clear, let's keep this a fair fight, okay? No strange powers, please and thank you.
Naturally.
Hmm? Don't just stand there, Jahoda — aren't you going to team up with me?
Huh? Do I have to?
Of course. Don't forget, the Curatorium has a reputation to uphold.
...I knew something like this was gonna happen!
Welcome home, Moon Goddess. Would you like to try on some animal-themed headwear?
(Ah... I always hear Lauma saying how heavy her antlers are. I wonder how it feels?)
(Let me give it a try...)
Oh my, it really suits you!
(It's a little itchy, and it's hard to turn my head...)
(Should I keep wearing it?)

dialogue.sit: I think I want to remove it for now.

dialogue.t: Alright! Feel free to come back if you change your mind!
...Sunny days! I prefer sunny days!
Aw, well you are as warm as the sun itself, Moon Goddess.
Very well, I believe your spirit animal has to be...
...This most adorable Chic Badger.
Wow! Thank you, Mister Talking Magic Lamp!
Haha. Have a very happy festival, Moon Goddess.
Flins? That's you, isn't it?
Shh. It's our little secret, my dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Uh... Okay, sure, but... Why are you here selling sugar sculptures?
Everyone celebrates in their own way. After gazing into the Abyss and spending time around gravestones all year, what better way to relax than to see sunny smiles on the faces of the living?
Besides that, I like to think of myself as a fair judge of character. I daresay matching personalities to confections suits me rather well.
That's not what Paimon was talking about! Aren't you afraid that your true identity might be exposed?
Hmm? Should I be? There is all manner of magic in the air this Moon-Prayer Night, thanks to the work of the great mages.
I see Miss Columbina is hiding in plain sight — why should I not do the same? Why miss this rare opportunity to enjoy a special evening in my true form?
Fair enough, you've got a point there. People who don't know you will probably think you're just a talking lantern.
Haha... Well, now that we see eye to eye, what brings you here? Not a search for your spirit animal, I presume?
Ah, well actually... Here, see for yourself!
Oh, this is... how wonderful. A beautiful idea.
Yeah. We just met Varka, and he said that having everyone draw their own section was kinda boring... so he did your bit for you.
Haha... Ah, Varka. Ever the maverick. I see his artistic skills are... truly one of a kind.
In that case, I shall paint something on Mr. Albedo's behalf in a short while.
What? Why not now?
...Ahem. Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
(...! That was close...)
Hello, Flins.
...She recognized you right away!
Haha, what keen eyes you have, Miss Columbina... Um, especially considering they are shut.
I did not see you. Rather, I sensed you. I can sense the fluctuations in kuuvahki all around me.
One would expect no less of the Moon Goddess. Might I interest you in some candy?
Yes, please.
Excellent, I shall make some for you right away.
...Hmm?
Something the matter, Miss Columbina?
...What about my "spirit animal"? All the other children carrying sugar sculptures are talking about it.
(Wait, is she taking the test seriously?)
Ah, my apologies. How could I neglect that?
You are quite right, Miss Columbina. Every one of us has a magical creature living in their heart. Would you permit me to help you find yours?
Yes, please.
...Do you prefer the day, or the night?
Night.
Which of the four seasons is your favorite?
Winter.
Think of a perfect day. What is the weather like? Sunny? Rainy? Or perhaps, cloudy?
Rainy in the morning, sunny at night.
(...What kind of answer is that!?)
Forests, lakes, and open seas — which do you prefer of these?
I like them all.
Imagine you opened your very own shop. What would you sell there?
Hmm... Moonlight, I think.
(Wow. Paimon would totally shop there.)

dialogue.sit: How much would it sell for?

dialogue.t: It wouldn't cost anything. You'd just need to visit.
Aha. I believe I know what your spirit animal is...
Here. For you.
Ooh, it's a kuuhenki!
Indeed. A free-spirited being with a deep love for all things here in Nod-Krai, who selflessly lends her aid to as many people as she can reach.
It is the perfect fit for you, Miss Columbina.
Heh. Thank you.

dialogue.sit: Now I wanna give this a try...

dialogue.t: Haha. It would be my honor, {NICKNAME}.
But you shall have to forgive me. We have known each other for quite some time... I doubt there is any answer I could give that would come as a surprise to you.
So, instead... would you accept this sugar sculpture as a token of our friendship?
It's a lantern...
Um... Heyyy, uh, why don't you two go enjoy your candy over there? Paimon wants to try out this "spirit animal" thing too! Right, Flins?
(C'mon, play ball, gotta get this drawing done!)
But I want to hear Paimon's answers...
Ah! But... it'll probably take ages! Paimon's a... complex soul! Uhh... And we don't want your candy to melt while you wait, huh?
Oh... Okay then.
Phew...
Nice excuse, Lady Paimon. That was some quick thinking.
Yeah, no thanks to you! A little help next time?
(It's sweet... Is that... Lakkaberry? I wonder what flavor {NICKNAME} got...)
This way, this way! It's the candy-selling lantern!
I'm coming!
(Ah! Of course...)
{NICKNAME}, maybe we can share?
Yes. I found out recently that people share their food sometimes, so I'd like to try it. Or... is that a no?

dialogue.sit: Oh, no, we can do that...
Just, uh, don't take too big of a bite...

dialogue.t: Thank you.
Hmm... Yours is a little more sour than mine. Here, you try it.

dialogue.sit: I'll just have a little nibble...

dialogue.t: Are you sure?
Haha... Amazing...
My sugar sculpture has shrunk, yet my heart is filled with feelings of sweetness.
...I will remember this feeling.
Sure.
"I wish for a never-ending supply of Lakkaberries..."
What a humble wish. Probably written by a child...
Hmm? Is that Lauma the Moonchanter...?
"I wish that the Longplume Ibises would stop biting me..."
Oh dear. Poor Lauma...
Alright. I'll write that one down for you.
Mm-hmm. I got it.
While everyone else is celebrating Moon-Prayer Night, you're as busy as ever...
I don't mind. It's rewarding work. A good kind of busy.
My antlers are at their heaviest tonight, and the kuuvahki waves are especially strong...
But as I help these dear friends hang their wishes up, I feel a great peace within myself that is hard to describe.
You see? They are all such beautiful wishes.
...And they are ones that we can fulfill by our own strength.
Do you blame me, Lauma? I want to hear your honest answer.
It is by the help of so many people that I can return to the moon... But I feel as though I've hardly done anything in return.
You've done plenty, Columbina.
I say this in earnest, both as someone who knows your history... and also as a friend, who has seen what you've been through.
What about as a Moonchanter?
Hah... I feel proud to honor our Moon Goddess's wish, and I'm sure any Moonchanter in history would have felt the same way.
Thank you for your kind words, Lauma.
But...
Hmm?
...Since you asked for my honesty, I won't lie to you. My feelings are mixed right now. Besides pride, I also feel...
I suppose it's... a reluctance to let go.
Once you return to the moon, we will be far apart, and separated by a false sky.
I'm sure those of us left behind will gaze up at that sky, yearning for the moon once in a while... just as you used to do.
I will miss you, Lauma. I will miss you all.
Hmm...
I hope to stay in touch. I will try and find some way to send messages down from the moon.
Perhaps you could use kuuvahki?
I've heard Jahoda say that signals can be sent using long and short waves, or strong and weak lights.
Hmm... That sounds a little complicated. What if we forget what the signals mean?
We could prepare a codebook beforehand, but... Heh, you're right. It wouldn't really suit you.
Still, whatever happens, I believe that you will find your own unique way of communicating with us.
And now that I think about that, my heart feels lighter.
Because you trust in me?
Yes, I have faith in you, and in the power of truth.
In my experience, the truth tends to be difficult. But that's what makes it stand out from what is false.
So, I'm confident that your thoughts and your love will shine through the curtain of lies. We will know it when we see it.
Thank you... Now, could you help me hang up my wish?
Is this...
I wish that all who dwell in this moonlit world can find a place to belong, and I wish that I shall one day see my friends again.
It's two wishes... I hope that's not too greedy of me?
Not at all. And I think you speak for us all with the second one.
I shall continue to pray until the day that all of these wishes come true.
Dodoco's Whirly Gig! Come check out Dodoco's Whirly Gig!
Ah, welcome home, Moon Goddess.
Might I ask what this is?
Ah, it's a very special amusement sponsored by the great mage herself! Ride on a soft and furry Dodoco, and embark on an unforgettable adventure!
(I say that, but I'm just following a script, here... Who is this mage, anyway? And what the heck's a Dodoco?)
I'd like to ride.
No problem. But, uh... are you by yourself?
Is that not okay?
Oh, no, it's fine. It's just that each Dodoco can accommodate two passengers. Would you like to bring a friend along?
My friends...
...That should do it. Now we just need to get everyone else to draw something on it too.
But we gotta keep it a secret from Columbina...
...{NICKNAME}.
I want to go on that ride. Will you join me?

dialogue.sit: (A spinning Dodoco? Ah, I see. It's a ride for two.)

dialogue.t: Let's go, then.
(...Don't worry! Paimon will do the rounds. You go have fun!)
Hmm...?
Alright. I think we have to wait in line over there...
Please take your seats. For safety reasons, you mustn't try to leave the ride before it comes to a complete stop.
Alright, you're all set! I wish you both a wonderful journey!

dialogue.sit: (You can always rely on Alice for weird and wonderful gadgets...)

dialogue.t: Not bad... It reminds me of riding a Moonlane.
Sometimes, the kuuhenki circle around me like this, playing their beautiful melodies.
Yeah. I'm going to miss them.

dialogue.sit: (I wonder what Columbina will find on the moon? ...Perhaps even she doesn't know...)
Does it... scare you at all?

dialogue.t: ...It does.
I've felt scared in the past, too. But this is a little different.
...You know something? I got to see a lot of fascinating things during my "disappearance."
I saw how the Frostmoon Scions act around their families... so different than how they used to act in my presence. And I also saw how they interact with their friends.
It made me curious at first. Why do people act so sincere when they're worshiping gods, but save their truest, warmest feelings for each other?
Slowly, I came to realize that... it's because they trust one another. They know, deep down, that they'll be accepted for who they are — all of it, the good and the bad.

dialogue.sit: Your friends accept all of you, too.

dialogue.t: I know. I knew it the moment you started calling out my name.
What I fear now is the end... I fear losing all this the very night I have gained it.
Hmm...?

dialogue.sit: Even after you return to the moon...
Your friends will still be here.

dialogue.t: Thank you for this conversation... Thank you for listening to me.
Don't worry. This fear I have, and the unknown that awaits me — they cannot hurt me. Not when I possess a treasure far greater.
I just... want you to remember this version of me, the real me, on this final night together.
Dear passengers, Dodoco's awesome adventure has come to a close. Please leave in an orderly fashion, and we look forward to seeing you again in the future!
...Hmm? Don't want the journey to end, huh?
Don't worry, you two. There's always another adventure waiting just around the corner.
Remarkable talent!
It's not too easy, is it? Still, I'm sure you'll familiarize yourself with Jumpy Dumpty's attack range in no time!
So, what do you make of it?
The use of Jumpy Dumpties doesn't come as naturally to me as kuuvahki. But their unpredictability makes it fun.
I think they call this... novelty?
Indeed! And how did it feel, blowing those pesky nuisances away?
Not bad.
Any guilt?
Hmm? What do you mean?
Wonderful! Lovely answers to all three questions. You've passed the safety test! Now, I can give this special bomb to you as a souvenir.
Remember, if you find any meanies living on the moon, you can use this to boom them into oblivion!
I will.
...I wouldn't say it's "unfair," exactly.
I mean, your voice goes right into peoples' heads. How would you explain that to the kids?
You can't just explain it away as magic...
Is something the matter?
Ah, Miss Columbina! No, nothing you need to worry yourself about...
Ah, impeccable timing! Stick around for a second, Miss Columbina. I need your input on something.
This self-proclaimed knight of justice has yet to give me a satisfactory answer. I, for one, would like to hear your verdict on the matter.
Ahem... Hey now, I left The Flagship just to help you out, Ms. Nicole...
What's going on?
So, Alice and I are both using long-range remote control spells that work on similar principles, allowing us to attend this festive fair in Dodoco form...
Sorry, let me backtrack a little — while similar, there are some key differences.
Alice, being a great mage, wanted her Dodoco to reflect something of her own charm and mystique, so she adjusted the way its tail moves when it spins around.
An entirely gratuitous move, in my opinion. I hardly see how anyone is going to notice that.
If anything, I'd say that anyone who stares intently enough at a Dodoco's tail to notice such a small detail is someone we ought to be highly concerned about.

I only say this to emphasize that my question has nothing to do with tails. Now that we're clear on that... Why is Alice's Dodoco permitted to interact directly with the children celebrating Moon-Prayer Night, while mine is not?
Your voice speaks directly into people's minds...
See? Exactly what I said.
Ms. Nicole?
Ugh... I can't stand it!
I know, that probably makes me sound like a whiny child acting out in front of their parents... hmm, and it's a little embarrassing now that I think about it...
But hey, I've said it now. I can't take it back — that would be even more embarrassing!
...Also, don't go reading too much into that analogy. It was off the top of my head. I'm actually an awful lot older than either of you...
Ms. Nicole, are you saying that you'd like someone to play the game you've prepared?
Eh, I'm not so invested in that. It's just something cobbled together using items I borrowed from Alice. She probably didn't even make them herself.
The point is, I want to know everyone's thoughts after they receive their prizes! But as you've said, I can't just ask...
I've been biting my lip for so long! And I've had no one to vent my frustrations on.
*sigh* I thought this was going to be a nice, straightforward festival where I'd get the chance to guide people to treasure...
Well, can I play? I can't guarantee that I'll win a prize, but...
You will?
I'd like to try.
Then what are we waiting for? Let the game begin!
(...It's like they forgot I was ever here. Hahaha.)
I know, that probably makes me sound like...
a whiny child acting out in front of their parents...
Hmm, and it's a little embarrassing
now that I think about it...
But hey, I've said it now...
I can't take it back —
That would be even more embarrassing!
Congratulations, Miss Columbina! With your great wisdom, you have overcome every obstacle in your path and conquered the great challenge posed to you by Fate.
Fate?
Well, something to that effect. If you'd prefer something more poetic, it could be... "the icy winds," or "the dawn"... anything you like, really.
...You could even go with "the challenge posed to you by Dodoco," if that's what you're into. Anyway, you can take or leave my suggestions. Moving on...
All my hopes are now resting on this.
Can I... open it now?
Stop teasing me! Please, I'm begging you — no more talk, just open it.
Wow... What a lovely sculpture. Classic and cute at the same time... Thank you, Ms. Nicole. I'll always treasure it.
Ahhhh, there we go... Music to my ears...
You have my sincerest gratitude, Miss Columbina.
Thank you for sharing your precious time with me and fulfilling my wish.
Don't mention it.
You've all done much to help me, and still I'm the one receiving all these gifts...
Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
Oh? You're the genuine article. Alice was right. This Moon-Prayer Night was worth watching after all.
Another one that talks...
Greetings, pleased to make your acquaintance. I am the Hexenzirkel member they call "B" — Barbeloth Trismegistus.
Columbina Hyposelenia. Pleased to meet you too.
Hyposelenia... Mm, a fine name indeed.
Now then, Miss Columbina... Do you wish to hear a mage's divination?
Divination... The Frostmoon Scions used to ask me what would happen in the future. Is this like that?
From the perspective of the one seeking answers, perhaps.
As you look to your journey ahead, if you seek to understand the unknown, resolve your doubts, and soothe the confusion in your heart... Divination could be for you.
The unknowns on my journey...
Of course, if one wishes to peer into "fate," then hydromancy is the more precise option.

But that is a complex affair, and to relegate that majestic art to the status of a festive amusement would seem somewhat uncouth. Besides... it is sometimes better to not know "fate" with great certainty.
Hence, I shall use the suitably festive Lunar Arcana to tell your fortune instead. It is more popular with the youth in any case.
Lunar Arcana...
Indeed. Unlike hydromancy, this will only display possibilities and trends.
People like think of themselves as creatures of agency and free will. Peering too far and too clearly into the future is detrimental to both body and soul.
I'd like to give it a try.
Of course you may. Come then. Take a seat, Miss Columbina.
Before we begin... Are there any specific questions you would like to ask?
Hmm... Let's stick to general possibilities and trends, like you suggested.
Ah, very well. Then I shall use the basic Lunar Arcana deck.
Now, try to relax. Cast your mind upon the things you have experienced, and the things you are soon to experience. I will shuffle the deck.
Would you like to the cut the cards yourself?
...You do it.
No problem. Now then, to make things easier for the seeker — that is to say, you — I shall decipher the cards from your perspective.
Please, draw the first Lunar Arcana. This represents "destiny," and is the foundation for the divination as a whole.
Now, draw your second card. This will stand for the "past," the sum of all your experiences that have come before.
And now the third Arcana. This is the "present," your interpretation of the current moment.
Finally, the last card. This shall speak of the "future," which... Oh?
Hmm? A... kuuvahki pulse?
Fascinating. I've never encountered this before in my role as a diviner. Something has exerted an influence upon this card, causing it to leave its designated position.
What do you make of this, Miss Columbina? Perhaps this is the guiding hand of fate in action.
Of course, if you wish, you can choose to deny the validity of this card and draw the "future" for yourself.
...No, it's fine. Let's go with this one.
A bold decision. I must say, I'm looking forward to the results.
Well then. Let us flip the Lunar Arcana in sequence, and see what emerges.
Sure.
First, "destiny." Ah, no surprises here. The card that represents yours is "The Moon."
The Moon...
Indeed. The moon can represent the truth at some times, but deception at others. False peace, destructive calamity, and the world-changing power that lies within.
When the Moon is placed on the destiny tile, it indicates that your destiny is not what it may appear on the surface. Instead, it may yet have a hidden side.
It symbolizes a journey through the fog, fraught with uncertainty and deception, where one must face inner challenges head on.
I don't understand...
Haha, patience, my dear. This is but the first card, which serves as a basis for the interpretations that follow. Our divination will only grow clearer from here on out.
Now then. Flip the second card, the one that speaks for the "past."
Ah, "The Hermit"... but inverted.
Inverted?
Yes. "The Hermit" symbolizes solitude, introspection, and the pursuit of truth. When inverted, it represents isolation, truth out of reach, and a path that leads one astray.
Combined with "The Moon" as one's destiny, "The Hermit" inverted represents...
A choice you made to stand alone in the past. It was a choice made not out of fear or arrogance, but for reasons that others could not perceive.
You fumbled through the darkness without a guide. But you did not find your way... rather, you went astray — more than once, it would seem.
(Is this about how I became Kuutar despite not wishing to become a god? And how I joined the Fatui because I yearned for a place to belong?)
I suspect only you know the answer to this question.
All is not lost. The past is in the past, and so shall it remain. Shall we look into the "present" now?
Oh my, "The Lovers." One of the most interesting Lunar Arcana.
What does this one mean?
This means that you have had an unprecedented emotional experience. The joy of finding your soul becoming intertwined with that of another... A precious and wonderful thing indeed.
It's true. I've made a lot of friends recently, and they are very good to me. I like them a lot.
That sounds lovely. I am most delighted for you. "The Lovers" can also represent important decisions, perhaps related to a parting of ways. Now, if I were to guess...
Yes... My return to the moon...
I understand. Parting with friends is never easy, Columbina.
But rest assured, this is not the end of your journey. There is always another story waiting to be told. The "future" always lies ahead.
The "future"...
Hehe. Well now, it's finally time to flip this most mysterious of cards. Why did it appear? And what does it wish to tell you?
I'm ready.
Very well. Flip this card and see what lies on the other side...
Oh...
Miss Barbeloth? What is it?
...This card is "Death."
That doesn't sound very good.
It depends on how we interpret it.
It is true that it can represent an agonizing death, a complete and utter end. But at the same time, it can also represent rebirth.
Do not forget that your destiny card is "The Moon." That lends your future many different potential meanings.
If death spells the end... is it unavoidable?
As I have said, divination can only display general trends. It is a rough guide, but it does not show predetermined outcomes.
Allow me to summarize it for you.
In the past, you may have lost your way, but now, you have gained new connections and new strength.
You now face an important decision, one that may bring about a great change in what is yet to be.
This change might, in turn, be the end of all things... or their beginning.
But remember, everything is subject to change because of "The Moon" present in your destiny. You must see the truth clearly and face your innermost thoughts.
The truth... my innermost thoughts...
Thank you, Miss Barbeloth.
Don't mention it. Some people dislike divinations, for fear of glimpsing an ending to their story that they wish was not so.
But I can see that you're different. The result of this divination will not sway your decision.
This is a rare quality, and one that diviners always hope to see in the seeker. We are here merely to guide, not to exert undue influence.
I understand.
Go then, and illuminate your future, Miss Columbina. The moonlight that shines from you now is most captivating.
Let's see now, let's see...
Wow, very good. That's the highest score we've had all night!
Ah, what a shame. But practice makes perfect! Another few tries and I'm sure you'll get it.
And here's your prize. Now, how about another round? As for the cost...
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, Miss Columbina.
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, Durin and Hat Guy. Are you here to play the game?

Yes.
No.
No.
You said we were just coming here to say hello...
I did, but then I recognized a few more people as I got closer.
(Do my eyes deceive me? Is that...?)
(It's our little dragon! He's all grown up!)
Tsk... Someone's popular.
Well now, since you came all this way, why don't you try out this lovely game we have going? First try is free!
He'll have a go. I'll pass.
Uh... It's only one free try per customer, you can't give your try to him...
I'm aware.
How has Elder Almond been lately?
He's in great shape! He goes for a run in the forest every morning to stay fit and healthy.
He tried to go boat racing with Firecracker a while back... But he couldn't even make it onto the lotus leaf. Firecracker was in fits of laughter...
How about you, little dragon? Can you still fly?
Yes, I can.
But you've become less chatty. Has growing up been tough on you?
We call that "maturity." You know, the thing people sing about!
"The knight wields a sword of stone, to defend those hearts that are made of gold."
Stone is very heavy. That's what keeps him from talking too much.
That's awesome! I wanna be a knight when I grow up, too! Ring, here I come! Hah!
Ah, the hat-wearing man. I never thought I'd see you again. You seem more determined than when I saw you last on the train.
If you say so.
I do say so. The people you once helped see it clearly... it's because you are once again on the right track.
May the engine in our hearts propel us to the station of our dreams.
I can move! I can move now, Rozel!
(What are they doing, running into the rings like that...!?)
You got them all so quickly...
(I have never seen anything like this in all my travels. Is this guy actually an old friend of theirs?)
(But how? They're origami animals and clockwork people from a fairy tale! Getting to know them would be quite an arduous task, unless... they share a hometown?)
(Hmm... I have to get to the bottom of this. Next time I see the Great Mage Alice, I shall demand answers!)
Thank you, Dori. I had a lot of fun.
Heh, so... now for your prize... Hmm, where did I put it? Give me a moment to... dig it out...
(Ohh, sweet grand prize... How I wish I didn't have to let you go!)
(Good thing I've already turned a profit from the customers earlier in the night. Otherwise, I'd have wasted all my hard work...)
Okay, *panting* I'm... I'm back!
What!? ...I leave for two seconds and someone's already claimed the grand prize!?
Ahaha, well, uh... Mm, these things happen, y'know? Perhaps you'd be interested in one of the other prizes instead? We've got all kinds of wonderful goodies here!
Ugh...
Hmm... Is this the thing you wanted?
Here, you can have it.
Huh? But...
Don't worry about it. It will be happier with you.
Thanks so much, Miss! ...Uh, I mean — Moon Goddess!
(Oh, goodness gracious, Columbina! Give me strength! How am I supposed to make any more money from this child at this rate!?)
Daddy, look! That's the game I was telling you about!
(*sigh* Forget it. She is the Moon Goddess, after all... I'll think of some other way to swing this. Maybe I can try to hook this new kid...)
Huh? Oh... Someone already won the grand prize...
...You can take mine if you want.
What!?
(Why, why, why? Why are all these bleeding hearts coming here to ruin my business!?)
Happy Moon Prayer Night, everyone.
Happy Moon-Prayer Night.
Well, well, look who it is? I heard someone went and disappeared on us the moment we let her out of our sight. They looked all over for you.
Frankly, I didn't think you'd be back for Moon-Prayer Night.
Were you worried about me, Sandrone?
Hah! You'd like that, wouldn't you? Do you even hear what you're saying?
It seems to me like you disguised yourself with festive headgear, just so that you could come see me on Moon-Prayer Night and make sure I'm okay. You didn't even bring Pulonia with you.
You...! I thought you couldn't see!?
I cannot, but I sense the confusion of those around us rippling through the kuuvahki currents.
Based on what I know about you, let me guess what you're wearing. Is it... cat ears?
Shut up! I'm only here to protect the Fatui's interests in this territory. Running into you was pure bad luck!
Really? But you were the one who asked Arlecchino to help everyone find my name...
Columbinaaaa! Just ONE more word, and I'll unscrew your vocal cords!
It's "Columbina Hyposelenia" now.
Tell someone who cares!
I've missed you, Sandrone. The whole time I was gone, I was thinking...
...I hope I get a chance to say some ugly words to you.
...Is that supposed to be a joke?
Anyway — let's go play that game.
What? You mean that Frostfin Whale?
Yes. It's some kind of game where you get bitten if you step on the wrong tooth. Seems like fun.
Who in their right mind would wanna—
...Because you're not a scaredy-cat?
Ugh...
Gah! Fine! You wanna play, let's play! Don't complain when I kick your sorry butt!
Lovely. Ah...
You old geezer! I'm gonna beat the pants off you, just you watch!
Hehe, I almost forgot. Sandrone?
Mmm? What is it now?
You'd better not lose, or I'm going to beat your head in.
...What!?
Ah! Argh!!!
I think you might have picked a bad tooth, Sandrone.
Shut it!
Do you need any help? It seems like you're stuck.
No!
It's just a blasted... toy... How is its grip this strong!?
Haha...
Stop laughing!
Alright. Well, you lost, so just like I promised...
H—Hey! What are you doing!? Are you seriously—
...Hyah!
Gah! Why, you— Just you wait!
Rematch!
Are you alright, Sandrone? That was quite a strong bite. Are your clockwork parts...
Quit your fussing. I don't need it!
Alright. I'll go first this time.
(I see it now. She can sense which teeth are rigged.)
(So I just need to avoid the same ones that she does.)
This one... Hmm, seems fine.
(She avoided that one, then? Hmph, now I've got you.)
Alright. My turn.
...What!?
Looks like you lost again, Sandrone.
Wait... There's more than one bad tooth!?
...Bonk.
Stupid game! What idiot came up with this!?
Are you alright, Sandrone? You said some nasty things just now.
Oh, I'm peachy.
Should I let you bonk me on the head as well?
Forget it!
Come on, bonk away. It can be your consolation prize. For losing so badly.
I told you, forget it!
Gah, you've always been so annoying...
Singing right outside my door, inviting yourself to my tea parties, going AWOL... and now you're off to the moon, or something!
Of all my days with the Fatui... The times I spent with you, Arlecchino, and Rosalyne... They were my favorite.
I will not forget them, just as I shall not forget this moment.
We'll always be friends, no matter where we are, right?
Who'd want to be your...
I'll miss you, Sandrone.
...Goodbye, Sandrone.
I'll... miss you too... Columbina...
Sorry? What was that?
Waah!
Waaah! Yeesh, no need to freak out... What's wrong? We've been looking everywhere for you.
What do you want!?
...Whoa, nice ears...
What... do... you... WANT!?
Uh, uh... th—this...
...Huh?
It's your turn to draw something. You're one of her friends too, aren't you?
Hmph. Doesn't know how lucky she is...
...Sorry?
Nothing. I'm done. Take it.
That was fast!
Oh, and one more thing.
Last time we spoke, you mentioned you were interested in the Narzissenkreuz Ordo's research. Remember? There were too many people when we last met, so we didn't get the chance to do this.
What are you talking about?

dialogue.sit: We'd like you have a look at this...

dialogue.t: This is— Oh... Alain, Rene... and Mary-Ann...
Huh... The Holy Blade... A savior's plaything.

dialogue.sit: You don't approve of their goals?

dialogue.t: It's not about whether I approve or not.
These people... They would sacrifice themselves for the sake of the world — especially Alain Guillotin and Rene.
That is something I would never choose to do.
Still... Heh. I didn't know they had any pictures left from that time.
If I'd thought to bring a Kamera, I'd have...

dialogue.sit: It's okay. We snapped a photo.

dialogue.t: ...What!?
Yeah, of you being bitten by the Frostfin Whale, and Columbina bonking you on the head.
Tear it up! NOW!!!
Moon-Prayer Candy! Beautiful, tasty Moon-Prayer Candy! Buy a whole box, share it with your friends and family!
(Candy... to share? ...Hmm, I wonder what flavors everyone would like...)
Welcome home, Moon Goddess! Fancy a box of Moon-Prayer Candy?
Sure.
I knew you would! Now, what flavor would you like?
I'm not sure... what flavors do you have?
Is this for yourself, or as a gift?
A gift for my friends.
Ah, I see. In that case, I'd recommend Apple, Lakkaberry , or Midsommar Berry. Those are the most popular.
Do you have Nocturnal Blossom flavor?
Huh. I've seen couples give those as gifts before, but I did not know they were edible...
No? Okay, then... Moonfall Silver?
Uhhh... You did say this was for friends, right?
Um... Maybe Smetana, then?
Hey, now that's a creative idea... I've never tried it before, but if you're happy to wait, I can see about whipping up a batch on the spot.
While we're at it... you got any other ideas?

dialogue.sit: Green grass. Krumkake. Extra-strong coffee. Columbina describes the flavors that come to mind.

dialogue.t: This doesn't make any sense! How am I losing every single time!? ...Wait, Ineffa! You're cheating, aren't you? Yeah, that must be it!
I am not cheating, Aino.
Uh-oh, sounds like Ineffa's turned into a big baloney-bot! I think it's time for some serious maintenance!
Ah. Moon Goddess. Help me...
Hmm?
Miss Columbina, Aino is attempting to cheat—
What the...!? I'm not the cheater, you're the cheater! How dare you throw it back at me!
Pfft... Hehehe.
...Alright, fine! Let's all laugh at Aino! Just wait till I get home, 'cause I'm gonna make a game bot that can win one hundred percent of the time!
Let's see you laugh when I come back and beat your butts! Hmph, you'll all have your heads covered in stickers when I'm through with you!
We came to check everything was okay after all that yelling... But, uh...
Pfft... hahaha!
Whatever it is, it sounds like cheating is allowed.
Kuuhenki Concentration.
Each player starts with differently colored kuuhenki. Each round, they draw one kuuhenki from their opponent.
When a player has two kuuhenki of the same color, they make a pair and can be discarded. Any that can't form a pair must be kept.
The round ends when a player can't form any more kuuhenki pairs, and that player gets a sticker.
Ooh! Can four people play as well?
That is fine, so long as the turn order is fixed beforehand.
Alrighty then! In that case, the two of us will join as one team!
Okay... but if you lose, you're both getting stickered! I don't wanna hear any excuses.
Sure. And if we win?
If you win... only one of you gets to sticker someone else.
I have taken to calling this "Aino logic."
Hey, lay off me, alright? Okay, so we're starting the game from scratch again, which means all my stickers so far don't count!
Looks like Luonnotar is the Kuuhenki of honor for this game. Anyway, let's go clockwise, starting from Ineffa.
Let me pick a good one... Hmm, what's it gonna be...
You're looking very pleased with yourself there... What happened to being a huge grumposaurus?
Hmph, I won. Duh.
Argh! Me again!?
Don't fidget too much, Aino, or the sticker's going to fall off.
I don't care! If it falls off, it falls off!
If a pair of kuuhenki get discarded, why not a pair of stickers, huh? Huh?
I've lost.
Sticker! Sticker! Sticker!
Hmm...
Cute!
You think so? Shame, I can't see it for myself.
Uhhh...
What did Luonnotar say?
She said it looks so cute that she wants me to lose a few more rounds...

dialogue.sit: After many more rounds, everyone's heads are covered in stickers...

dialogue.t: "I wish that all who dwell in this moonlit world can find a place to belong, and I wish that I shall one day see my friends again."
"If only Miss Lyylikki would notice me..."
"I really hope my boss gives me a raise..."
"I want to adapt to human society more quickly."
"Hope things go smoothly on the journey with {NICKNAME}, and that Columbina's travel goes well too."
"I wish that the Longplume Ibises would stop biting me."
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, adventurers. May you have a lovely evening.
I've seen Lyney and the other children play this game before. It would seem that it's not a bad way to relax once in a while.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Candy? Huh. Would you mind if I took a handful extra? I'm sure the children will enjoy them.
I must say, Columbina, you really have changed. You never used to show this much consideration for other people, even when prompted.
I'm sure Sandrone would agree when I say... I like the present version of you better.
Heh. That was fun. It's a shame Ashru doesn't like playing with water, or I'd have roped him in as well.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Oh? A gift? You shouldn't have, Miss Columbina.
Mmm... Very nice indeed. Candy is one of many luxuries that the desert folk could never afford.
How I yearned for candy when I could not have it... Yet, now that it is readily available to me, I never seem to crave it.
May your Moon-Prayer Night be one free from regrets.
Phew... I just had a water fight with two Fatui Harbingers... Pretty scary... But also surprisingly fun.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Aw man, this feels kinda wrong... Like, shouldn't we be the ones giving you candy rather than the other way around?
Um... I... I guess I'll just... take one.
(Ugh! What flavor is that!?)
(It tastes like... getting a mouthful of muddy grass... after being rear-ended by a Blunthorn Rhino, then face planting the ground...)
(...Ugh, I'll never get this taste out of my mouth...)
I—It's delicious, ahaha... Mmm...
Welcome home, Moon Goddess. Would you like to try on some animal-themed headwear?
(Which one should I try?)
(Should I keep wearing it?)

dialogue.sit: I think I want to remove it for now.

dialogue.t: Something about festive lighting always has a way of putting the warmest smiles on people's faces.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: This is most thoughtful of you, Miss Columbina. Kindness exudes from your heart like benevolent moonlight.
Forgive me, but I shall have to enjoy this gift a little later. I hope that the flavor I chose is not the only one of its kind.
If others were denied the chance to sample such kindness as you have shown to me, it would be a great pity indeed.
Yes. May everyone's wishes come true...

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Why, thank you... Don't mind if I do.
Oh my. It's so sweet...
I'm so accustomed to plain, simple meals that this sweet treat is quite a shock to the senses...
But I savor this moment in its entirety, because... It tastes like true friendship.
Dodoco's Whirly Gig! Come ride on a soft and furry Dodoco, and embark on an unforgettable adventure!
Of course, Moon Goddess. This way, please!
Fun ride, huh? You and Columbina looked pretty sad to leave.
Hmm... This isn't gonna make Paimon dizzy, is it...?

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Ooh, candy for us? Thanks a bunch, Columbina! Don't mind if we do!
Whoa, this one's intense! Mmm, but it's sooo tasty!
What about you, {NICKNAME}? How does yours taste?

dialogue.sit: Like Smetana, I think... A very novel flavor.

dialogue.t: Sounds good! Paimon's drooling now... Are there any more Smetana candies in the box?
Yes, I believe so.
Kay, gotcha. Let's see...

dialogue.sit: Have you tried any of them yourself?

dialogue.t: Ah...

dialogue.sit: Paimon, could you pick out three Smetana-flavored candies?

dialogue.t: Sure!
This one, and... Yep, this one looks right, too... Okay, that's three!
Here we go. One per person!
It's so sweet!
A soft and furry creature that bounces and jumps...
Welcome home, Moon Goddess.
Ah, this one talks, too...
Ahem. Allow me to introduce myself. I am a Dodoco from a distant archipelago — the most mischievous of all my Dodo-brothers and Dodo-sisters!
When the going got tough, I powered through, and when I met obstacles, I boomed them away!
That sounds like a lot of fun.
Doesn't it just! Ah, but then the trouble started.
Recently, I found a lovely beach, the same, beautiful jelly color as my hometown, and so I dove in to have a look...
Only to find it overgrown with seagrass, and nasty little Spikey Fish everywhere, looking to turn me into a Dodoco kebab...
I made it back to shore by the skin of my teeth, but my tail tail was sorely hurt!
Couldn't you just... boom them away?
Oh, I wanted to, believe me! But I've heard that you, Moon Goddess, can understand animal-speech.
The last thing I wanted was cause a gigantic fuss and get taken to court by a school of Spikey Fish. I'd be driven out of these waters for good! And my winter holiday would be ruined!
And so, dear Moon Goddess, I was wondering if you might lend me your allegiance...
Are you roping me into a crime?
Ahaha! Let's call it a once-in-a-lifetime, carefree adventure. Does that sound better?
All the festival-goers tonight are dressed up as the Moon Goddess. But there's nothing to say that the Moon Goddess can't disguise herself as a Dodoco, is there?
Besides, this is your home. You should be free to be whoever you wish.
I'm afraid I'm not well acquainted with Dodocos, Madame Mage...
Oh, that's quite alright! We Dodocos are innocent, happy creatures with a free-spirited nature.
Many, like myself, are mischievous troublemakers. Others are lazy souls who like nothing better than to lie down on a nice rock and take a nap.
In our eyes, every creature who yearns for happiness and freedom is a Dodoco!
But perhaps in yours, we Dodoco are... a fluffier and more mischievous breed of kuuhenki?
Yes, that is a much easier image to follow.
Wonderful! Then let's play. Grab onto my tail tail, and follow me into the sea! Time to settle some scores with the bad guys!
Up for another round of fish blast— I mean, of bye-bye bad fishies?

dialogue.sit: Yes. Hello there. I am the Moon Dodo-Goddess.
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Wonderful! It's Dodoventure time!
Oh me, oh my! With your help, Miss Columbina, we've blown every last blade of annoying seagrass and each nasty Spikey Fish out of the water!
You truly are a kind-hearted Moon Goddess! At last, I am free to enjoy myself once more in these waters.
I hope we meet again at the next festival!
I don't suppose you'd... like to play again, by any chance...?
Don't get me wrong, once is plenty. You're under no obligation to indulge me any further... and besides, I don't have any other prizes for you...

dialogue.sit: Sure, I'll play again. This is fun.
Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Great! I mean, if you say so...
Is it really all that much fun, though? Huh. My tastes must be falling seriously out of step with the majority...

It'd be rude to just leave without saying anything... But at the same time, I don't wanna barge into their lively conversation just to announce that I'm leaving... Eh, I guess I'll just wait a little longer.
...Albedo?
This sketch is for you, Grand Master.
Oh? A gift for me? Thanks. Let's see what you've done for me...
The North Wind, Left in the Lurch.

dialogue.sit: Mr. Albedo, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Mr. Varka, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Thank you.
Mm... It seems I've picked lemon. It strikes a good balance between sweet and sour.
This has piqued my curiosity. What if we were to add citrus and other spices, then enhance the flavor via caramelization? I wonder what the end product would be like?
Perhaps I should take the time to try this out.
The "Death" card made a most enigmatic appearance...
The moon for which Miss Columbina is bound... I fear...
...Fretting is of no avail. I will have a chat with Alice about it sometime.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Ah, you're such a polite child, Miss Columbina.

But we elders have already partaken of our fair share of stories in this world. Enjoying candy, keeping up with the hip and groovy trends of the day... these things should be left to youngsters like you.
I hope you don't misunderstand me — I do not intend to lecture you, or reject your kindness.
It is simply that... the mere sight of this candy is starting to give me a toothache.
Done being a do-gooder yet?
Thanks for coming here with me, Hat Guy.
Are there any games you'd like to play? It's your turn to pick. I'll come with you.
...Why does that hamster think you've grown up? You haven't changed at all.
I know you don't mean that. You're just taking the opportunity to make fun of me, aren't you?
Even if you won't admit that taking some time to compose yourself is important, I can see that you're doing it in practice.
Otherwise, you'd have taken off your hat and flown away by now.
Looks like Albedo's socialization program has been far more useful to you than all those Vahumana textbooks.

dialogue.sit: Durin, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?
Hat Guy, would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: A Moon-Prayer Candy for me? Thank you...
It smells like... baked apples and butter.
Reminds me of Good Hunter, a restaurant in Mondstadt... I always have to resist the temptation to go there, unless I'm ordering food.
I understand your homesickness, Miss Columbina. I have a double dose of it...
Because both Simulanka and Mondstadt are my home.
If all the prizes are gone, I might as well close up shop for the day. But you haven't had your fill of fun yet, right?
So, the next time a customer shows up, you're going to have to run faster, alright?
And remember — run out of the rings, not into them!

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Oho? A gift, for me? Ah, Lord Sangemah Bay really is going up in the world!
(Wow, candy from the Moon Goddess herself! If I bagged this up... no, what am I saying — boxed this up, in exquisite gift boxes... Yes! I could make a fortune!!!)
(Hmm... Maybe I don't even need to go to all that trouble. Any old boxes will do — I just need to tell my customers that this candy is blessed by the Moon Goddess. Yeah, that oughtta do it...)
(Hehe, sounds like a plan. Time to have Urwa earn his keep when I get back...)
What's there to see on that moon, anyway...?
Hmph, let her go up there and cry alone. See if I care...

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: You're giving me candy? ...That isn't like you. This had better not be some weird prank...
Hmm... coffee flavor? I thought you hated coffee... Mm, it's extra-strong, too. Hah! You didn't do all this just for me, did you...?
Hey, hey! Don't take it away! I never said I didn't want it. I mean, you can't unmake the candy now...
Assorted Moon-Prayer Candy! All your favorite flavors in a box! Alright, kids, just line up over here...
Hmph. I'm never playing games with you ever again, Ineffa!
Aino is throwing a tantrum again... I believe it will take three krumkakes to constitute a suitable peace offering.

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Ooh, Moon-Prayer Candy! Sweet! Is it okay if I grab a whole bunch?
Psst, Columbina, turn around! Use your huge cloak to block Ineffa's vision!
Yum! Ooh, and this one's even yummier...
Ugh... The flavors are blending in my mouth... Eww...

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Scanning candy composition and ingredient ratios...
Selection confirmed. I would like the krumkake-flavor.
...Flavor profile simulates real krumkakes with 27% accuracy. This is a non-viable substitute for Aino's afternoon snack.
One moment, please.
Done. Please sample this freshly-baked krumkake, Miss Columbina.
...Ugh. I really thought you were gonna send me home...
Where did you learn to scare people, huh? Bad! Bad Ineffa!
Do you see this, Aino?
It's a krumkake! You made it yourself, didn't you? Wait. How did you know I was hungry?
Correction: You are not hungry. You merely desire food.
However, consuming extraneous snacks is acceptable during a festival. Come, celebrate Moon-Prayer Night, Aino.
Yay! You're the best, Ineffa! Festivals. Are. Awesome!
C'mon, Citrus, one more round! Just one more!
But my neck— ah! Oof... It's acting up again...
You should take a break. Health comes first.
Yeah, don't push yourself. We'll find someone else!
Hey, don't look at me. I'm just the referee.
What are we gonna do, then?
Do you need any help?
Yes we do. We need one more player for our game.
Alright. Could you teach me how to play?
It's really simple. You just throw the dice and move by that number of tiles. First one to reach the finish line wins.
Rolling a hamster means you move one step forward, a paper frog is two steps, and a flying squirrel is three steps — 'cuz they go the fastest.
Okay, I get it.
So we're all set?
In that case, please take your places... and let the game begin!
(What is going on over here? It looks like fun...)
Hold it right there! You can't run away from me, Moon Goddess!
Hmm? Are you talking to me?
Of course! Do you see anyone else here dressed up as the moon goddess besides me and you? Hey, c'mon, call me by my title!
Happy Moon-Prayer Night, Moon Goddess.
Hehe, and the same to you!
Anyway, there's no time to waste. Get ready... for the duel of a lifetime!
Um... a duel?
Meet my partner, Stacko. Come on out, Stacko!
Don't just stand there! Let's see your partner!
Partner...?
Pee-weeet!
Hmm? ...So I need to select a partner and command them in battle?
Partner... I need a partner...
Beep.
Whoa, am I seeing things? Where'd you get a kuuhenki!? They're super rare!
That's great — buuuut, you can only bring one partner to battle against me and Stacko. No ganging up allowed!
(They all look so eager to be picked... Hmm... Which one should I choose?)

dialogue.sit: (Hmm, I wanna give this some more thought.)

dialogue.t: (This one usually lives in Nasha Town. She likes falling asleep to the sound of striking hammers... And I bet she's quite familiar with robots' weak spots.)
Testing, testing... This is an emergency broadcast — an exciting battle is about to take place right here at the Nasha Town special arena!
In this corner, we have the Moon Goddess and her robot partner...
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her kuuhenki partner.
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her Rimehorn Deer partner.
And in the other, we have... the Moon Goddess and her... other robot partner.
(Gah, this announcer stuff is harder than I thought! Why does everything I say sound so dumb? If I could cringe any harder, I'd fold in on myself!)
Only one Moon Goddess can be victorious in this ultimate battle of destiny! But who will it be? There's only one way to find out!
Now, without further ado... Let the battle of the moons begin!
I don't care who we're up against — Stacko and I ain't gonna lose!
Beep-beep!
Let's strike first! Stacko, "Formation Shift"!
Ohh! The robot has kicked things off with a change of formation. But how will this affect the battle? Nobody knows!
The other party chooses to attack! Let's see how their partner performs!
Beep.
Stacko...!
The attack lands! And if those sizzling sounds are anything to go by, it was very effective!
Okay then... Stacko, maintain formation, and enter your empowered state!
Empowered state! There we go, now we're talking!
Absorbing the immense kuuvahki present on Moon-Prayer Night, this lean mean machine has greatly increased its offensive power!
Good choice! Buffs count for nothing if you beat 'em before they can use it!
Beep.
It's a hit! But Stacko stands firm...
The battle is heating up, fast! I'm about to start sweating machine oil over here!
Go for it, Stacko! Set kuuvahki to maximum!
Can their opponents withstand this blow? And what will this Moon Goddess do?
Don't be afraid. Fight however you wish.
It's... it's a Moonlane!
A deft use of a Moonlane allows the kuuhenki to dodge the blow... and now it's spiraling around its foe in circles!
One loop... Two loops...! The robot's screen is bugging out — it's getting dizzy!
What the... The Rimehorn Deer's antlers are glowing!
It absorbs the kuuvahki from its opponent... and uses that same power to deal a devastating counter attack!
There goes the robot's formation!
Beep.
And... it's the empowered state!
Both robots empowered now... the attack comes in, but oh! Attacks repelled! Opposites attract, but likes repel, and now you've seen it in action!
What a powerful repulsion! The robot crashes into the wall! Can it keep going?
Stacko...!
Stacko is down for the count. Our winner is... the Moon Goddess! Uh, the slightly taller one, I mean.
You did your best, Stacko. I'll take you to Aino's for a checkup right away, don't you worry.
Beep...
*sigh* Well, you beat me fair and square, I guess... Honestly, I underestimated you. Won't make that mistake again.
I think my partner deserves most the credit.
Hmm... Just you wait! When I'm a little bit older, I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!
Hmm...
Hmm, I don't have enough data. Need more samples... But who should I ask for help?
Is this... one of the amusements? Or is it a research project?
Bit of Column A, bit of Column B!
I'm currently running some synchronization tests on these bots...
Basically, you need to press the button to help them successfully obtain the treasure — but you've gotta time it right.
I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.
But, Ma'am... I mean, Moon Goddess, don't you think you should take your eye mask off first?
There's no need. I will be alright.
Okay then. Whatever you're comfortable with.
Great, then let's begin.
Would you like to try again? I'll record your data, which will be used to improve the robots' accuracy.
Cool! So much useful data... I'm progressing much faster than I expected!
Thank you so much, Moon Goddess.

dialogue.section: (Invite Lauma to take a photo together...)

dialogue.t: If this were any other day, I'm sure it would make for a great photo opportunity. But Moon-Prayer Night has rendered my antlers uncomfortably large...
Doesn't it look like... this Rimehorn Deer has two sets of antlers?
And, done! Here, take a look!
...I think it looks quite funny.
Well, Paimon thinks it's super cute!
It looks like... a silly Chic Badger and... a Rimehorn Deer that's about to fall asleep.
Hmm. Maybe I'll stand on the Chic Badger's side instead.
It looks like we've attracted the attention of quite a few animals... Let's make room for them.

dialogue.section: (Invite the Rimehorn Deer to take a photo together...)

dialogue.t: Goodness gracious! I've got to go back and tell my kids I took a photo with our great Moon Goddess!
Thank you so much, Moon Goddess!
It's a pity that my good friend, Faurobert is busy working on a training program for Princess Cimest.
If he could've been here, the victory might've been his.
Meow~

dialogue.sit: Would you like some Moon-Prayer Candy?

dialogue.t: Meow?
I have a fish-flavor one if you'd like?
Meow...
Of course. If you prefer Mint, then Mint it is.
Meow.
Hehe, don't mention it.
I'm gonna come back a whole lot stronger! Be ready for a rematch!
Miss Lyylikki, a kitten's been following you all this time.
Oh. So it has.
Hello there, little kitty. May the moon light your path.
Did Lady Lauma send you? Or was there something you needed?
Meow~
Hmm? You'd like some Moon-Prayer Candies?
Meow~
No?
I believe... it wants that box. The one with the Moon-Prayer Candies in it.
...Ah, I see! Here, kitty, come on. Here you go.
Meow~
Thank you, Lady...
Huh? Mr. Kantor, did you see that young lady dressed as the Moon Goddess? When did she leave?
Sorry, no, I was looking at... Um, I was watching the... cat.
I see...
The resemblance was uncanny... She seemed like the true Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, the one who guides souls...
Aren't you gonna sleep, winged ones?
No way! This is Moon-Prayer Night. No one sleeps on Moon-Prayer Night!
No one sleeeeeeeps! No one sleeeeeep, sleep-sleep sleep-sleep—
Shush! Be quiet. You're hurting my head with all that racket...
Wait a sec... That's the Moon Goddess. The real Moon Goddess! And she's looking this way...
Idiots! You're blocking her way!
Brother, I've just been through a breakup... Console me, brother. Ease my aching heart.
What was it you told me a while back? "The scent of love is in the air"...
So I thought... but alas, 'twas but the scent of dirt in the ground.
Oh yeah? Well, I'm sorry, but it sounds like your dumb nose is playing tricks on you.

dialogue.section: Moonglow Firefly, Moonglow Firefly, Moonglow Firefly, Kuuhenki

dialogue.t: How many times do I have to tell you? When you spin around, look up at the moon! The MOON, got it? Not at me! Do I look like a moon to you!?
Sorry, Teacher!
And... again!
Stop! ...You, at the back. You're behind the beat!
This dance is supposed to be simple! Focus up, or you'll be practicing till next Moon-Prayer Night at this rate! Again!
Lemme guess, you're angry because of what I said, right? I can tell, because now you're going too fast! You're ahead of the beat!
Sorry, Teacher... It's so noisy here, I... I can't hear the beat...
Miss Kuuhenki? Um... Are you sure it's no trouble?
Then thank you — yes, we'd love to have you play the accompaniment.
Alright, look sharp everyone! Time to step it up! Show me your best moves!
Five, six, seven, eight!
But I was aiming right at it...
Ah, what a pity. I saw it with my own eyes — you were so close, so, so very close...
That's not true! It dodged outta the way right as I was about to snag it!
I'm sorry?
You heard me! This paper frog can move! I swear!
Dear, oh dear. What are you saying? How could a paper frog move? Unless you believe there really is magic in this world?
But even if I, the mere humble merchant that I am, knew such magic, surely I would not use it on a paper frog! I'd sooner give Mora legs, so it could walk right into my purse.
My dear, dear customer... Why not have one more try, hmm? This time, I'll give you... 12% off! A very generous discount for one of my most regular customers!
Just think about how much experience you have under your belt now! You're sure to win the next one!
Um...
Darn, I used up all my coins. I'll be right back — just gonna fetch some more from my house!
Take your time! But, uh, don't take too long. This event is Moon-Prayer Night only. Miss it, and you'll have to wait a whole year before I'm back.
Next customer, please. Welcome!
Hello.
(Whoa, whoa, what's this bigwig doing over here!? Ugh, how do I tell my employees not to go running around this time... Shooting them a glance won't work — I haven't known them long enough!)
Dori?
Why hello there, Miss Columbina. Would you like to play my ring-toss game? The rules are very simple, and it's easy to get the hang of...
How much for a round?
Oh, first time's free! Not a single Mora! After that — well, we can cross that bridge if and when we come to it...
But with your sharp eye— I mean, sharp skills, I'm sure you'll win all the prizes in one fell swoop!
(That was an obvious enough hint for them, right? Right...?)
{NICKNAME}.
Hey there, Columbina! Are you done checking out the festive amusements already?
Are you sure you don't wanna look around some more? You might not get another opportunity like this for a while...
(Right now, what I'd like to do is...)

dialogue.sit: (...Actually, I'd like to have a bit more fun.)

dialogue.t: You're right... I'm not ready for this night to end just yet.
Yeah, that's the spirit! Take your time, Columbina. The most important thing is to have no regrets!
We'll be right here if you need us!
Okay, thank you.
{NICKNAME}, Paimon.
Columbina! Finished with the festival already?
(...Actually, I'd like to have a bit more fun.)
Okay! No need to rush, just take it easy.
This was the most fun I've ever had on a Moon-Prayer Night.
Everywhere I went, people were saying "welcome home." And there were friends at every turn.
I only wish it could last longer than one night.
Oh...

dialogue.sit: Your friends will always be here.

dialogue.t: Yes. You're right. I...
Ah, the Moon-Prayer Blossoms...
Ooh, look, look!
Moon-Prayer Night is here!
The moon... It's so beautiful...
